subject: POC kickoff — need to swap slot + prep items for prompts/routing/load test
messages:
From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request to move POC kickoff (resource conflict)

Hi Marcus / team,

Quick heads-up — we just had our data infra lead pulled onto an unexpected outage and won't have the right folks for the POC kickoff scheduled tomorrow at 11am PT. Would you be open to swapping to either Monday May 3rd 10am PT or Tuesday May 4th 2pm PT?

We still want the hands-on session (prompt review, routing rules review, and the short load test run), but need the right engineering attendees. I attached a short agenda so you can see who we want to be present.

Also: for the load test, we expect to validate steady-state 50 rps for short burst windows and a routing path that falls back to a cheaper variant under saturation — we can provide expected concurrency and a few sample prompts if that helps.

Thanks,
Sanjay
Sanjay Patel
Head of ML Platforms, Acme Analytics
Attachments: POC-Agenda.pdf (pdf)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to move POC kickoff (resource conflict)

On Sun, 2 May 2027 at 09:12 Sanjay Patel <sanjay@acmeanalytics.com> wrote:
> Quick heads-up — we just had our data infra lead pulled onto an unexpected outage and won't have the right folks for the POC kickoff scheduled tomorrow at 11am PT. Would you be open to swapping to either Monday May 3rd 10am PT or Tuesday May 4th 2pm PT?
>
> We still want the hands-on session (prompt review, routing rules review, and the short load test run), but need the right engineering attendees. I attached a short agenda so you can see who we want to be present.

Thanks for the note and sorry to hear about the outage — totally understandable. Monday May 3rd at 10am PT works for me and Vanessa; Lauren is on call for product but I've cc'd her to confirm availability.

To make Monday productive, here's a short prep checklist we'd like to run through — I'll attach a markdown copy to this thread: 
- Confirm sample prompt set (examples + expected distribution of token lengths)
- Provide expected concurrency/throughput for the load run and any SLO targets
- Confirm routing intent: primary model variant, and fallback behavior for cost vs latency
- Share any data redaction or PII constraints for prompts/logging
- Confirm who will run loadtest client (your infra or ours) and network constraints (VPC peering, region)

If you can drop the sample prompts and concurrency numbers before EOD today we'll pre-stage the routing profile and quantization profile to hit your target during the run.

Plain calendar invite: I can send an updated invite for Mon 2027-05-03 10:00-11:30 PT if that works — confirm and I'll update.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
redwood.ai
Attachments: redwood-prep-checklist.md (text)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@acmeanalytics.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to move POC kickoff (resource conflict)

Thanks both — Monday 10am PT is fine by me. Quick operational notes from my side: 
- For the 50 rps target Sanjay mentioned, please confirm whether that's sustained for 5 minutes or a shorter burst (we prep batching/kv-cache differently).
- If Acme will run the load generator, please share the client IP ranges or let us know if you want Redwood to run it from our dedicated pool.
- We recommend sending a representative prompt set (10-20 prompts) that includes edge cases (long chains, many function calls) so we can validate routing fallback.

Lauren — tagging you for product questions on routing policies we should stage (A/B vs fallback + cost threshold).

—Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to move POC kickoff (resource conflict)

Perfect — Monday 10am PT confirmed. Sorry for the scramble. Couple quick items we'll provide before EOD today:
- Prompt set (attached) — ~18 prompts, mix of short/long and a couple function-calling examples.
- Concurrency: plan is to simulate a 60-second ramp to steady 50 rps, hold for 3 minutes, then a 2-minute cooldown.
- We prefer Redwood to run the load from your dedicated pool (minimize our infra setup) — please send any IP ranges if needed.
- Routing: primary = rtx-13b (low-latency), fallback = rtx-6b-quant (cost-optimized) with a 300ms latency threshold.

Looking forward to Monday. I attached the prompt set file.

Thanks,
Sanjay
Attachments: acme-prompt-set.txt (text)
